verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single marketing line saying Conduit 'adds the security and observability IT teams need' (mcp.pipedream.com). That hints at some observability layer but describes no actual usage analytics. Per-user headers (x-pd-external-user-id) suggest usage could be attributed per user, but no analytics surface is documented. missing for 10: documented call-volume metrics, per-user usage views, error tracking, cost reporting, any dashboard or analytics API docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
